title.zh: 轴对称圆电流丝 Green 响应

summary: 逐源求和理想圆电流丝的实际坐标磁通与极向场响应，保留源权重和精确自点离散零约定。

identity.relation: weighted circular filaments to axisymmetric flux and poloidal-field response
identity.direction: filament R-Z-weight rows and target R-Z points -> gpsi, gBR, gBZ
identity.definition: 以已验证的实际坐标圆环核逐源相加，psi=R A_phi（Wb/rad）；小椭圆参数用等价超几何表达与解析场导数，避免K/E消差。每源无量纲权重乘一次，调用者随后乘外部驱动电流。
identity.model: vacuum axisymmetric circular current-filament Green relation
identity.geometry: circular filaments and point targets in an axisymmetric domain
identity.boundary: 只精确零半径或零权重源无贡献，所有正半径源保留。轴上目标psi=BR=0，BZ=mu0*w*a²/[2(a²+h²)^(3/2)]。精确源目标重合的贡献按历史离散兼容规则为零；其他算术非有限不填零。
assumptions: Weights are dimensionless relative source strengths.
The returned response is per external drive ampere applied later by the caller.
精确自点为离散兼容值，不代表有限导体自场或自感；空源数组保持本入口的历史空集简写。

inputs.name: rzw
inputs.constraints: Finite with nonnegative source radii; an empty source set is allowed.

outputs.name: gpsi
outputs.constraints: Finite under the maintained singular-value convention.

outputs.name: gBR
outputs.description: Radial field response per drive current.
outputs.constraints: Finite under the maintained singular-value convention.

outputs.name: gBZ
outputs.description: Axial field response per drive current.
outputs.constraints: Finite under the maintained singular-value convention.

preconditions: Inputs use SI cylindrical coordinates and finite numeric values.
supported: Axisymmetric vacuum response of weighted circular filaments.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for wrong array rank/width, nonfinite values, or negative radii.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: 核或源求和的不可表示输出、上溢、除零、非法运算抛FloatingPointError；不把算术故障替换为零。
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this operator has no iteration.
failure_semantics.partial_results: 失败不返回部分响应；精确自点是预声明离散约定，单独保留为零。

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel implementation with frozen internal admission evidence; private review identifiers are not part of the public contract. 本后继保留冻结前行为为证据，修正近轴剔除、非有限静默填零或人工场核偏移/截断；psi统一明确为RAphi，单位标签Wb/rad，不乘2π也不改存储数值。

example.description: Evaluate one unit-weight filament at two off-axis targets and check response shape and finiteness.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.field import circular_filament_green_response
result = circular_filament_green_response([[0.35, 0.0, 1.0]], [[0.2, -0.1], [0.2, 0.1]])
assert set(result) == {'gpsi', 'gBR', 'gBZ'}
for value in result.values():
    assert value.shape == (2,)
    assert np.isfinite(value).all()
example.expected: Three finite float64 response vectors with two entries each.

scope: Midplane symmetry and analytic axis BZ check.
独立70/80位精度理想圆环关系核对极小正半径、近轴非零BR、近丝和公式求值分支，保持原数值断言与容差；精确离散自项与算术失败分别处理。
verification.evidence_ceiling: Verified for the maintained axisymmetric circular-filament relation and tested finite points; not an independent validation of arbitrary coil geometries or singular self-fields.
known_limitations: Targets exactly on a filament are not a resolved self-field model.
Public distribution licensing remains pending a human decision.
聚合求和入口与逐源矩阵入口保留不同形状/空源接口；共同核复用不合并公共合同。
